name: official-usememos
title: Official-Memos-Extension
description: Capture, find and manage your Memos notes without leaving Raycast.
author: youscef

commands.name: setup
commands.title: Setup Memos
commands.subtitle: Connect to Memos
commands.description: Connect Raycast to your Memos instance and check that your access token works

commands.name: search-memos
commands.title: Search Memos
commands.subtitle: List Memos
commands.description: Search your memos and preview them rendered as Markdown

commands.name: create-memo
commands.title: Create Memo
commands.subtitle: Create a new memo
commands.description: Write a memo in Markdown, preview it, and save it to Memos

commands.name: capture-memo
commands.title: Capture Memo
commands.subtitle: Quickly capture a memo
commands.description: Type a memo in Root Search and save it immediately

commands.name: save-clipboard
commands.title: Save Clipboard as Memo
commands.subtitle: Save the text on your clipboard as a new memo
commands.description: Save the text on your clipboard as a new memo

commands.name: open-memos
commands.title: Open Memos
commands.subtitle: Open your Memos instance in the default browser
commands.description: Open your Memos instance in the default browser

preferences.name: instanceUrl
preferences.title: Instance URL
preferences.description: Address of your Memos instance, e.g. https://memos.example.com. Leave the default to try the public demo.
preferences.placeholder: Use https://demo.usememos.com, or your server URL

preferences.name: accessToken
preferences.title: Access Token
preferences.description: Create one in Memos under Settings → Access Tokens, e.g. https://demo.usememos.com/setting#access-token

preferences.name: defaultVisibility
preferences.title: Default Visibility
preferences.description: Visibility for new memos created from Raycast

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
